pages.title: Nature's Ritual
pages.text: Nature's Ritual gathers a central catalyst, salted offerings, and the vigor of cultivated land at a Ritual Table. Its workings may transmute an item or call forth a living creature.

pages.title: Ritual Ground
pages.text: Set $(l:hexalia:blocks/ritual_brazier)Ritual Braziers$(/l) freely around the table. They need no fixed formation, but must share the table's Y level and lie within 8 blocks horizontally. A ritual may call for any number of offerings.

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: Place the recipe's central catalyst on the table. Put one required offering in each nearby brazier and add $(l:hexalia:resources/salt)Salt$(/l) to those braziers. Offerings may be arranged in any order.

pages.title: Activation
pages.text: Use a $(l:hexalia:content/tools#hex_focus)Hex Focus$(/l) on the prepared table. The ritual chooses only the braziers needed to match its offerings; unrelated or surplus braziers are ignored.

pages.title: On Growth
pages.text: Nature's Ritual depends on surrounding life. Nearby fully grown crops are consumed in the process, returning to early growth as their energy is drawn into the ritual.

pages.title: Result
pages.text: When the working completes, the catalyst becomes the result and only the selected offerings and their salt are consumed. Used braziers then return to rest.

pages.title: Soul Offerings
pages.text: Some summonings require a soul. After the offerings finish, the ritual waits: slay a nearby living creature with an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l) to give the waiting working its final breath.

pages.title: When It Will Not Begin
pages.text: Check the catalyst and offerings, salt every brazier the ritual actually needs, and ensure enough fully grown crops stand nearby. A soul is required only after a marked summoning has accepted its offerings.
